audio.subtitle: The time for reckoning has come.
Doom has come to this world!
The Legion has returned to consume this world!
Are there none left to stand against the Legion?
I wonder why Mannoroth even bothered with you.
I've had fun scouring your wretched nations.
We would have launched this invasion centuries ago...
Soon, I will order the invasion to begin.
You may still prove useful to us.
No! Put down your weapons! This is not necessary!
Nothing will stand in our way!
His gaze pierces cloud, shadow, earth and flesh.
You do not know pain, you do not know fear!
We have only to remove those who oppose us.
There would be no dawn for men.
Do you know how the orcs first came to being? They were elves once.
One ill turn deserves another. It is over.
Stain the land with blood of our enemies!
You have elected the way of pain!
You are all going to die!
Time? What time do you think we have?
What is the house of Rohan but a thatched barn where brigands drink in the reek and rats roll on the floor with the dogs?
It would be wise, my friend.
As you see my powers are far beyond yours!
Good! Twice the pride, double the fall!
One ring to rule them all, one ring to find them, One ring to bring them all, and in the darkness bind them.
Something fester in heart of Middle-Earth. Something that you have failed to see.
Save your pity and your mercy I have no use for it!
The old world will burn in the fires of industry. Forrest will fall. New order will rise.
I'm sure you did the best you could. We will discuss your failure later.
Does he seek to humble me with his new found piety!
Your love of the halfling's leaf has clearly slowed your mind.
New power is rising! It's victory is at hand!
We will drive the machine of war with the sword and the spear and the iron fist of the orc.
That is why you have come, is it not?
Time? What time do you think we have?
I want them armed and ready to march within two weeks!
The hour is later then you think.
Hunt them down! Do not stop until they are found!
You've interfered with our affairs for the last time.
Why should we fear to use it?
How can you kill a God?
What a grand and intoxicating innocence!
Is this how you honor the Sixth House and the tribe unmourned?
I wait for you there, where we last met, countless ages ago.
Together let us free the cursed false Gods.
How could you be so naive?
Come, Nerevar, friend or traitor, come.
Come. Lay down your weapons. It is not too late for my mercy.
Welcome, Moon-and-Star, to this place where destiny is made.
Together we shall speak for the Law and the Land!
No Recall or Intervention can work in this place.
This is the end. The bitter, bitter end.
Better luck on your next incarnation.
How sweet it is to be a god!
Come to me openly, and not by stealth.
Forgive me but I am enjoying this.
Throughout the aeons I have been known by many names...but my true name of power...is Carl.
Behold before you, the illustrious, the imperious, ingenious arch-mage... Carl.
Oh, they'll rue the day they crossed me!
Like a match already dim and damp, your mind snuffs out.
Whatever that was, twas scarcely worth my notice.
All can be known, and known by me.
Whosoever stands against me, stands briefly.
You'd have done better to clothe yourself in knowledge, for all the good your scraps of armor did you.
Darkness and ignorance take you all!
I must have stepped on something.
Fools die... as you well know.
Can't you see I'm under attack?!
What need have I for this?
It falls to me to inform you that this one is in the bag!
Cause for my enemies to dwell on me exclusively!
Let the world end now, it matters not to me.
I find myself strangely drawn to this odd configuration of activity.
What is this, a game of some sort?
A dark interval, and now a bright one.
What is this nature you speak of?
You might wish to retract your last move.
I am unfamiliar with this feeling. Is it joy?
Regrettably, I remove myself from sight.
I do enjoy an occasional blink.
I know exactly what you mean.
I can only show you the door. You're the one that has to walk through it.
You think that's air you're breathing now?
Welcome to the desert of the real.
All I'm offering is the truth. Nothing more.
We well know that the reason that most of us are here is because of our... affinity for disobedience.
I'll show you how deep the rabbit hole goes.
That sounds exactly like the thinking of a machine to me.
Don't think you are, know you are.
Then hit me. If you can.
You have to let it all go. Fear, doubt, and disbelief.
Some of you believe as I believe, some of you do not. But those of you that do, know we are nearing the end of our struggle.
What is The Matrix? Control. The Matrix is a computer generated dream world.
I wasn't aware that my actions required any explanation.
As you no doubt have guessed, I am Morpheus.
I don't believe it to be a matter of hope. It is simply a matter of time.
Unfortunately, no one can be told what the Matrix is. You have to see it for yourself.
Come on. Stop trying to hit me and hit me!
My apologies to all. As you are undoubtedly aware, it has become increasingly difficult to locate a secure broadcast position.
I believe very soon the prophecy will be fulfilled and this war will end.

What is "real"? How do you define "real"? If you're talking about what you can feel, what you can smell, what you can taste and see, then 'real' is simply electrical signals interpreted by your brain.
I didn't say it would be easy, I just said it would be the truth.
Faith, it seems, is not without a sense of irony.
You have the look of a man who accepts what he sees because he's expecting to wake up
The prophecy will be fulfilled soon. But before it can be, The Oracle must be consulted.

We've survived by hiding from them, by running from them. But they are the gatekeepers. They are guarding all the doors, they are holding all the keys. Which means that sooner or later, someone is going to have to fight them.
I'm trying to tell you that when you're ready, you won't have to.
What was said was for you and for you alone.
How would you know the difference between the dream world and the real world?
I imagine that right now, you're feeling a bit like Alice. Hmm? Tumbling down the rabbit hole?
Now you will experience the full power of the Dark Side.
Use my knowledge, I beg you.
Once more the Sith will rule the galaxy.
In time you will call me... Master.
Your feeble skills have no match for the power of the Dark Side!
From here, you will witness the final destruction of the Alliance, and the end of your insignificant rebellion.
There is a great disturbance in the force.
Ironic. He can save others from death, but not himself.
I'm too weak! Oh, don't kill me!
The dark side of the force is a pathway to many abilities some consider to be unnatural.
I can't hold on any longer.
There is glory in this... probably.
The bard will tell tales of this.
You will fall, like so many others before you!
The light shall reveal your duplicity, foe.
We'll do no good standing around. Get off of Facebook and let's go adventure!
Blood on the cobblestone, and secrets in the alleys. I have no love of the city.
Come at me. I await, you devils.
I've always loved the sunshine. The day cast light no treachery may hide from.
My spell is ruined. I must try again.
Evil may lurk around every corner, but so do we! Steel yourself, villains, we approach.
Urgh! The gods will welcome me, fiend!
I love the smell of the trees and grass. Small reminders that there are yet places evil has not crept.
No! My friend. I will avenge you!
Hrrm! We must change our tactics, I'm having no effect.
I would if I could, but I won't. Because I can't!
An honour, truly. But there are no leaders amongst friends.
Dark intentions whisper, just out of earshot. But with every dusk, comes a dawn!
Well... there we go! I suppose...
I slip away, ready to strike.
Evil never slumbers, but... I do. We should rest.
And now for taste of things to come!
The Emperor will not tolerate failure.
Tomorrow morning the great kombat begins.
You are all witnesses to one of the greatest turning points in the history of your planet.
Liu Kang! You will be first!
It's an honour to finally meet you.
You're here to compete in Mortal Kombat.
I've plans for my beautiful Sonya.
But it is my boat and if you'd like a tour I'd love to give it to you myself.
Kung Lao's ascendant is competing in the tournament.
It's not time for foolish pride!
Save your pity for the weak!
From this moment on my island will be your battleground.
We've never been so close to absolute victory.
Treasure these moments as if they were your last.
Princess Kitana is 10,000 years old and the rightful heir to the throne of Outworld.
If any more words come pouring out your cunt mouth...
Tougher girls than you tried to kill me!
How did a mad fucker like you live this long?
Listening to talkers makes me thirsty.
You're shit at dying, you know that?
Come on, you can do better!
Bring me one of those chickens.
Killing is the sweetest thing there is.
Unless there is a Maester hiding behind that rock...
This one's been killed six times, you don't hear him bitching about it.
If I live, I'll brake both of your hands.
There's no divine justice you dumb cunt, if there was you would be dead.
I'm leading a mob of peasants!
Everyone I've ever met has been a cunt.
Shut the fuck up so I can get some sleep.
You won't last a day out there.
